faqs.question: How can I check my attendance?
faqs.answer: Open the Attendance page from the dashboard to view your subject-wise attendance.

faqs.question: Where can I find my examination schedule?
faqs.answer: Open the Exams page to view upcoming examination dates, timings and rooms.

faqs.question: Where can I find study materials?
faqs.answer: Open the Materials page to access available notes and study resources.

faqs.question: How can I check my results?
faqs.answer: Open the Results page from the dashboard to view your marks and grades.

faqs.question: How can I register for an event?
faqs.answer: Open the Events page and check the available events and registration details.

faqs.question: Who can I contact for academic help?
faqs.answer: You can contact the student help desk or your respective faculty member.
